subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian tennis players won the men's doubles title at the Bangkok Open Challenger held at Nonthaburi, Thailand in January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuki Bhambri and Saketh Myneni.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yuki Bhambri and Saketh Myneni **won the men's doubles title at the** Bangkok Open Challenger **held at **Nonthaburi, Thailand** in **January 2023.**
 
• Yuki Bhambri is a professional Indian tennis player who has won** six singles **and** 14 doubles titles** on the ATP Challenger Tour.
 
• Saketh Myneni is also a professional Indian tennis player who has won** two singles** and **16 doubles titles** on the ATP Challenger Tour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Arjun Kadhe** is a tennis player from India.

 
 
• Kadhe is the **four-time ITF **Futures singles champion.
 
• He also holds **seven ITF Futures doubles titles** and three challenger titles.
 
 
 
• Indian tennis player** Rohan Machanda Bopanna **plays professionally.
 
 
• In 2012 and 2015, he advanced to the** ATP World Tour Finals** as a finalist.
 
 
 
• Indian tennis player **Ramanathan Ramkumar **plays professionally.
 
 
• He has played in the **Davis Cup** for India. 
 
 
 
• Indian male deaf tennis player **Prithvi Sekhar** plays the sport.
 
 
• In the mixed doubles competition at the **2017 Summer Deaflympics**, he and Jafreen Shaik took home a** bronze medal.**
